items.constraint: Actual OIDC/MFA/origin/cookie/provider and IAM acceptance not exercised
items.mitigation: Fail-closed native identity and scoped role contracts; gate broad access

items.constraint: Pattern redaction cannot recognize arbitrary proprietary secret/PII formats
items.mitigation: Bounded redaction and no raw public evidence; approve profile and representative private fixtures before real data

items.constraint: Chat and automatic work still share regional provider quotas and model throughput
items.mitigation: Separate worker/host capacity, distributed chat allowance and bounded work; qualify provider capacity before activation

items.constraint: Live erasure does not erase PITR/exports/provider/email copies; TTL/lifecycle is asynchronous
items.mitigation: Minimal anti-replay tombstones, private purge registry, isolated restore with new signing key/release and grant reconciliation

items.constraint: Reference-answer tests do not establish generated diagnosis quality or eliminate prompt injection
items.mitigation: Exact citations/corroboration, no execution, rejected-draft isolation; repeated paid synthetic evaluation and human approval remain gated

items.constraint: Actual key/provider/workload rotation, rollback and recipient removal unqualified
items.mitigation: Conditional epoch/release rebinding, retained version labels and exact reviewed subscription diffs; rehearse with independent operator

items.constraint: Access trail configuration is not proof of delivery and data events incur customer costs
items.mitigation: Narrow selectors, retained encrypted audit destination, fail-closed application records; require receipt/digest and budget approval
